name: walk in the sun
source:
Claire's got one goal - to spend time with her friend Jamie after school. 

Nothing's going to get in the way of that.

[From [url=https://gg8473.itch.io/walk-in-the-sun]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Claire只有一个目标——放学后和朋友Jamie共度时光。

没有什么能阻止她。

[来源：[url=https://gg8473.itch.io/walk-in-the-sun]Itch.io[/url]]
